items.label: Size Guide
items.value: US SIZE, X-Small=(US 0-2), Small=(US 4-6), Medium=(US 8-10), Large=(US 12-14), X-Large=(US 16-18). This ribbed tank has medium thickness, perfect for spring, summer and autumn's layering.

items.label: Unique Design
items.value: Knit tanks will be popular in 2026, knit has a rich texture. Feel the warmth of fashion stitch by stitch. This basic knit features a classic square neck, sleeveless, ribbed texture, slim fit, solid color, casual and simple style.

items: The basic trendy square neck tank top subtly reveals the delicate collarbone, and with a vintage necklace, it instantly enhances the fashion sense of the overall look. This kind of matching not only makes the neck look slimmer, but also emphasizes the good figure of women.
Great everyday tanks—soft, stretchy and cute for layering or wearing solo, easily dressed up and down and goes well with everything for perfect outfits.

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Perfect for daily wear, vacation, going out, dating, offices, home. First tank for spring/summer outings, nice undershirt for fall/winter inner wear. This sleeveless top is a must-have for every woman!

items.label: Care Instruction
items.value: Machine wash with a laundry bag, hand wash cold, and do not bleach; Vacuum sealed, slight wrinkles are normal and will smooth out with regular ironing or washing.
